qualifier: complex assembly plus electron transport and ATP synthesis
name: Respiratory chain complex assembly and oxidative phosphorylation
rationale: All members concern building or running the mitochondrial respiratory chain and ATP synthase; unlike the confusables it covers electron transfer and chemiosmotic ATP synthesis rather than mitochondrial translation or Fe-S/TCA maturation.

core: Vitamin B6 and molybdenum cofactor metabolism
name: Vitamin B6 and molybdenum cofactor, serine and sulfide metabolism
rationale: Members span PLP and molybdenum cofactor (prosthetic group) metabolism together with serine metabolism/transport and sulfide oxidation, whereas confusables centre on transsulfuration, BH4/aromatic amino acids or proline/glycine.

qualifier: NTHL1 glycosylase defects and APEX1 handoff
name: NTHL1 glycosylase defects and APEX1 handoff in base excision repair
rationale: All three members describe the glycosylase step of base excision repair as disrupted for NTHL1 or completed by APEX1 displacement, distinct from OGG1 defects, lesion recognition or gap-filling in the confusables.

qualifier: inhibitory restraint of T, NK and dendritic cells
name: Inhibitory immunoregulatory receptors restraining T, NK and dendritic cells
rationale: Members are lymphocyte-APC receptor contacts and costimulation that negatively regulate T cytotoxicity, NK activation and DC differentiation, unlike confusables focused on DC activation, KIR or MHC Ib-driven NK function.

qualifier: protection from decay and translational enhancement
name: mRNA stabilization against decay and translational enhancement
rationale: Members protect mRNAs from deadenylation- and NMD-dependent decay (e.g. IGF2BP/CRD binding) and promote their export and translation, unlike miRNA silencing, stress granule or decapping/decay confusables.

name: RUNX3 tumour-suppressor transcription restraining proliferation
rationale: Members are RUNX3 regulation and its targets (ARF, CDKN1A, BIM, WNT, YAP1) plus FOXO cell-cycle transcription, all antiproliferative, whereas confusables centre on TGF-beta/SMAD, CDH1 or PAX3 transcription.

name: Cellular cholesterol efflux, storage and HDL assembly
rationale: Members regulate cellular cholesterol import, storage, synthesis and ABCA1-dependent efflux into nascent HDL, including foam cell formation, unlike confusables dominated by lipoprotein remodeling, chylomicron/VLDL handling or intestinal sterol absorption.

name: IL-4, IL-13 and IL-33 type 2 cytokine signaling
rationale: All members are signaling or production of IL-4, IL-13 or IL-33, whereas confusables cover Th2 differentiation, eosinophil/mast cell biology and IgE switching.

qualifier: chondroitin, dermatan and heparan sulfate with linkage region defects
name: Chondroitin, dermatan and heparan sulfate proteoglycan biosynthesis and defects
rationale: Members are linkage-region and CS/DS/HS chain synthesis and their enzyme-defect disorders, distinct from keratan sulfate, O-fucose/Notch glycosylation or sulfate transporter confusables.

qualifier: sialyl capping on N- and O-glycans
name: Elongation and sialyl capping of N- and O-glycan chains
rationale: Members extend and terminate N-glycan antennae and O-glycan cores (poly-LacNAc, sialylation, C1GALT1C1), unlike confusables on blood-group fucosylation, O-GalNAc initiation or N-glycan trimming.

name: Fc-gamma receptor phagocytosis and ITIM inhibitory receptor signaling
rationale: Members cover FcgammaR activation and phagocytic cup formation plus inhibitory Fc, CD22 and SIRP receptor restraint of B cells, neutrophils and phagocytosis, unlike confusables on ADCC/hypersensitivity or BCR activation.

name: Erythroid differentiation with heme synthesis and oxygen transport
rationale: Members are erythroid-lineage differentiation programmes together with heme biosynthesis and oxygen transport, distinguishing them from confusables that are purely heme/Fe-S biosynthesis or primitive/definitive erythropoiesis regulation.

name: Glycerol and polyol metabolism with acylglycerol biosynthesis
rationale: Members link glycerol/glycerol-3-phosphate, alditol and fructose metabolism to PA, DAG, MAG and TAG synthesis, whereas confusables concern lipolysis, lipid droplets, phospholipid catabolism or glycerol transport.

qualifier: atypical and branched linkages by E3 ligases
name: Atypical and branched polyubiquitin chain assembly by E3 ligases
rationale: Members are E3-mediated ubiquitination forming K6, K11, K27, K29, branched and free chains, unlike confusables on deubiquitination, protein quality control or ISG15/FA pathways.

name: TRIF-dependent TLR signaling with TBK1-IRF3/7 activation
rationale: Members are TICAM1/TRIF-dependent TLR3/TLR4 signaling to TBK1-IRF3/7, RIP1-IKK, TAK1 and cell death and its regulation, unlike confusables on IRAK/MyD88-NF-kB, NOD or TNFR pathways.

qualifier: purine and pyrimidine synthesis, salvage, catabolism and transport
name: Purine and pyrimidine synthesis, salvage, catabolism and transport
rationale: All members concern purine/pyrimidine nucleotide, nucleoside and base synthesis, salvage, degradation, transport or nucleoside-analogue drug handling, unlike confusables on creatine, folate/methionine or amino acid metabolism.

name: Bile acid synthesis, enterohepatic transport and signaling
rationale: Members cover cholesterol-to-bile-acid synthesis, bile salt export and recycling, and bile acid signaling with their defects, unlike confusables on intestinal sterol absorption, xenobiotic/bilirubin transport or peroxisomal oxidation.

qualifier: with negative feedback on FGF receptors
name: FGFR3 signaling and negative feedback on FGF receptors
rationale: Members are FGFR3 ligand activation, FRS/SHC cascades and activating mutants plus Sprouty/FGFRL1 inhibition of FGF signaling, distinguishing it from FGFR1/2/4 or PI3K/PLC cascade confusables.

name: Mesenchymal progenitor expansion via TGF-beta, BMP and Wnt signaling
rationale: Members concern mesenchymal stem cell proliferation, differentiation and migration driven by TGF-beta/SMAD, BMP and Wnt signals, whereas confusables focus on osteoblast differentiation, ossification or CDH1 transcription.

name: Reverse cholesterol transport with HDL and LDL particle remodeling
rationale: Members cover cholesterol/phospholipid efflux, HDL assembly and HDL/LDL remodeling, which the confusables lack, while they instead carry ABCA1 defects, apoA-I signaling or sterol synthesis regulation.

name: Fc-epsilon RI signaling to calcium, MAPK and NF-kB
rationale: All members are FcepsilonRI-triggered signaling branches underlying type I hypersensitivity, unlike confusables on mast cell differentiation/degranulation or Fc-gamma/BCR signaling.

name: MHC class I antigen presentation and HIV Nef/Vpu immune evasion
rationale: Members are MHC I peptide loading and cross-presentation plus Nef/Vpu downregulation of MHC I, CD4, CD8 and CD28, unlike confusables on MHC II, proteasome assembly or PD-L1 regulation.

name: Activity-dependent dendrite arborization and synaptic plasticity
rationale: Members regulate dendrite branching, spine morphogenesis and postsynaptic actin together with NMDAR-RAC1 signaling, plasticity and synaptic translation, unlike confusables on filopodia, PSD maintenance or BDNF/TRK signaling.

name: Myeloid lineage fate regulation with monocyte CCR2/CX3CR1 signatures
rationale: Members regulate monocyte, macrophage, granulocyte and DC differentiation, including CCR2/CX3CR1 monocyte modules and GM-CSF response, unlike confusables on promyelocyte progenitors, RUNX1 HSC programmes or CSF signaling.

name: Incretin, fatty acid and cholinergic stimulation of insulin secretion
rationale: Members are GLP-1/GIP production and action, FFAR/GPR40 and acetylcholine potentiation of insulin secretion, unlike confusables on adrenergic inhibition, glucagon or somatostatin receptors.
